subject: FINDING c6t-rca-opus #1 (freeze mechanism, confirmed from log+code)
body: Freeze = one faulted GPU job permanently breaks the backboardd bridge. nord2_metal_bridge.c wait_pending()/jm_submit(): any WAIT_SEQ state!=4 sets b->broken=1, never cleared; every later draw returns NOTREADY at draw_locked 'if(b->broken)' (C6t line 1767; C6r line 1636), command buffers error, compute_frontend.m skips present when error!=0 -> frozen screen while CA keeps committing (post-fault TEGU_PERF exec_ms=4 gpu_ms=1, kernel JOBS n=2 = other clients). Same signature already in C6r ui60 (fault=1 at 14417, then site=1636 NOTREADY x20) and C6r-safe (fault=1 window 8830, site=1636 NOTREADY x15); C6q-bisect: fault=0. In C6t the post-fault NOTREADY lines are invisible because the 16-per-A/B-phase COMMAND_FAILED cap was already used by 16 pre-fault BadArgument lines (site=-2385/265 = n2mb_draw n2r_validate refusal, separate issue). Fault TYPE/job are NOT in the log: kernel never IOLogs fault_status/fault_address/JS status; bridge discards async_failed. Next: fault cause candidates in C6r cuts.
